explanation: The same claim this milestone makes about Cabral’s landfall and for the same reason. Nothing about three ships in October 1492 predicts a traffic that began a century and a half later and was carried mostly by other powers. What the voyage did was make the islands a place Europeans went to, which every later step here needed and none of which it contains. The weak type, and it is the honest one: the chain is not an argument that Columbus caused the Atlantic slave trade.
